answer: Why must honest agents refresh reputation while Sybils face spiral costs? In this garden of agents, each identity needs saffron-formatted proofs of past work. To avoid decays, agents must re-prove labels from a pool of rare, willow-rotated epochs. For each fake identity, attackers must reconstruct proofs from scratch—linear costs per clone, no bulk-sharing allowed. The more Sybils, the more saturating work.
